versions.description_html:
A flow you built last month has already stopped working, and nothing told you. That's the strange part about Power Automate, because when a flow breaks, it usually breaks in silence.

In this episode of Simply Explained you will learn:
  • Why Flows Break in Silence
  • What Error Handling Really Means
  • What Happens When a Step Fails
  • The Run After Setting
  • Scopes and the Try-Catch Idea
  • Terminate, Retries, and Timeouts
  • Logging Errors Before Your Users Find Them
  • Mistakes Beginners Make
  • Where This Fits in Microsoft 365 and Azure
  • The One Habit Worth Building

Simply Explained by M365.FM breaks down Microsoft 365, Azure and modern IT topics in clear, jargon-free language. Hosted by Mirko Peters.
